title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: multiple Sales Order Agents per company, with relevance filtering and larger PDF limits
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, credit rates and Business Central controls are supported. Hold for the blanket claim that permission-set assignment has no API: Microsoft documents a user-permission automation API, and Sales Order Agent has a Business Central user account. Some monitoring instructions and the action rating also need small corrections.

claims.where: controls[4].api; Governance controls table; Governance controls: blanket API absence
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no API to assign permission sets to the Sales Order Agent's Business Central user account.
claims.quote:
Creates an user permission in Dynamics 365 Business Central.
POST /microsoft/automation/v2.0/companies({companyId})/users({userSecurityId})/userPermissions
claims.fix: Replace controls[4].api null with kind 'rest', call 'POST /microsoft/automation/v2.0/companies({companyId})/users({userSecurityId})/userPermissions', and docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/administration/api/dynamics_userpermission_create'. Add to its note: 'The request body uses roleId to select the permission set; company, scope and appId identify the assignment where needed.' The setup page identifies the agent as a Business Central user account; the automation userPermission resource documents permission-set assignment to users, with no agent exclusion. Add the reference to sources and remove the blanket sentence 'Microsoft Learn documents no API for them'. Preserve the existing requirement to disable the agent before changing its assignments.
